jobs.title: GTM Ops
jobs.descriptionHtml:
GTM Ops

A hands-on build and execution role. You turn campaign briefs and ICP requirements into accurate, highly targeted prospect lists, check their quality and launch the campaigns.

Remote · Latin America · Full-time · Independent Contractor · Monday to Friday · 8:30 AM-6 PM EST

Why this role exists

Our client is a full stack go-to-market agency that helps B2B SaaS founders build outbound pipeline and grow revenue, combining email and social outreach, founder content and hands-on sales support. This is a brand new role, where one person builds a list, another checks it and another launches it. You can do all three. You work closely with everyone. When a leader is not available, you make the call: you come with two possible solutions, not only a question.

What you'll own

  • Target account and contact lists built from detailed client ICPs and campaign briefs
  • Targeting requirements translated into clear data filters, using judgment on each situation instead of only following rules
  • Leads enriched with company, contact and campaign data using Clay, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Prospeo, Apollo, AI Ark and Blitz
  • Lists segmented, with customer lookalike audiences and TAMs built
  • Data cleaned and deduplicated
  • Every list checked before launch for company fit, correct titles, exclusions in place and no missing data
  • Campaigns uploaded into outbound platforms such as Email Bison and HeyReach
  • Monday.com and Slack kept updated throughout the day, so the team always knows where each task stands
  • AI agents such as Claude used effectively, with every output checked manually before it enters the system

Why this is interesting

  • You work with the entire team and take a list from the brief all the way to launch
  • Outbound campaigns for B2B SaaS founders
  • You use AI every day, with a team that expects you to understand concepts like MCPs and APIs and to know where AI falls short
  • A team that keeps up with the latest software and approaches, and expects you to do the same

What we're looking for

  • Hands-on experience building prospect lists, ideally in Clay
  • Comfortable with LinkedIn Sales Navigator and data platforms such as Prospeo, Apollo, AI Ark or Blitz
  • Logic and judgment: you decide based on the situation, not only based on a set of rules
  • You use AI well and know its limits, and you stay in the loop instead of offloading the work
  • You take initiative and bring solutions
  • You can jump between complex projects quickly and stay calm and focused
  • Clear communication: you acknowledge messages and keep Slack and the project board updated
  • Highly organized and growth minded
  • Strong written and spoken English

Bonus

  • Experience with Monday.com
  • Previous experience in an outbound or lead generation agency
  • Hands-on experience with Email Bison or HeyReach

What success looks like

First 90 days
You pick up tasks quickly and deliver accurate lists efficiently. You communicate clearly, stay organized and work well with every member of the team. You can take a list from the brief through the quality check and into the launch.

Ongoing
The results of your list building are the main measure of your work. You keep a high standard under pressure, make decisions on your own when the leaders are unavailable, and keep learning new tools and approaches that improve the team's campaigns.

jobs.title: Inspections Coordinator
jobs.descriptionHtml:
You’ll own the daily inspection calls and scheduling for a US home-services company, making sure every permit gets closed out on time.

Remote · LATAM · Full-time · Independent Contractor · Early morning US Eastern shift (approximately 6–7 AM to 2–3 PM ET, with some flexibility)

Why this role exists

Our client is a plumbing and construction company in the US. They run a busy appliance installation side, where almost every job needs a permit and an inspection. Inspections happen after the work is done, but they protect the company’s license and close out every permit. They also hold up the whole operation if they aren’t closed.

There is a large backlog, over 150 inspections at different stages, and hundreds of new inspections and permits come in every week. The owner is building the system from the ground up: a customer booking portal that connects to the technicians’ schedule. It will cut about 30 hours a week of back-and-forth with customers. By the time you start, the process will be organized and documented. You’ll learn it alongside the owner and then run it.

You’ll report directly to the owner. The team (owner, plumbing coordinator, office team) works together in a WhatsApp group. Everyone has their own role, and the work is a cascade: if one step isn’t done, the next person can’t do theirs. The owner needs someone they can trust to do the job without being chased. 

What you’ll own

  • Call town inspectors within their narrow windows (often one hour, same day, e.g. 7:30–8:30 AM) to book the day’s inspections
  • Start every day with a checklist of who to call, for which inspection, and at what time
  • Plan one or two days ahead so no call window is missed
  • Track bookings in the spreadsheet and send booking links to customers
  • Tell each inspector which jobs are scheduled and when, and check them off once confirmed
  • Keep the owner informed when a stand-in is needed so plumbers aren’t double-booked
  • Work down the backlog by prioritizing the towns with the most outstanding permits, then close out town by town
  • Handle both past inspections (the backlog) and new inspections and permits
  • Navigate the rules of around 50 Massachusetts towns, each with its own process
  • Tools: Google Sheets, WhatsApp, FieldPulse

Why this is interesting

  • You’ll learn a system built from scratch with the owner
  • A new booking portal will automate much of the customer scheduling
  • A small, close team where each role matters and your work is visible
  • Autonomy and trust: the owner doesn’t want to micromanage
  • A real impact on the business, since closed inspections keep the company running

What we’re looking for

  • Highly detail-oriented, someone who notices what needs doing and adds it without being told
  • Extremely punctual and reliable. Missing a call window means missing the whole day.
  • Comfortable with Excel or Google Sheets (the whole system runs on spreadsheets)
  • Computer-savvy and eager to learn new systems
  • Proactive and self-directed: does the job without being checked on
  • A confident, personable communicator, bubbly but with a backbone, who can handle (and win over) tough inspectors by phone
  • Able to work an early US Eastern morning shift 
  • Fluent English for daily phone calls with US inspectors and customers

Bonus

  • Previous permitting experience
  • Experience in the trades or home-services industry

What success looks like

First 90 days

  • You’ve learned the system and can run the daily call routine with little guidance
  • The backlog is shrinking steadily
  • No missed inspector call windows

Ongoing

  • You run inspections independently, with no need for follow-up
  • The team can trust that inspections are scheduled and closed without being checked
  • You keep up with new inspections and permits, including peaks around US sale seasons (Black Friday, New Year’s, Presidents’ Day, tax-free weekends, July 4th)

jobs.title: Operations Coordinator (Home Services)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Operations Coordinator (Home Services)
Location: Remote (Latin America)
Hours: Monday to Friday, 7:00 AM – 3:00 PM ET

Join a busy, growing home service company
Our U.S. client has two teams: one installs home appliances and one handles plumbing. The appliance team has a full office behind it. The plumbing team is growing fast, and the owner still takes every call and chases every job himself. You will be his right hand. You will answer the plumbing calls, book the jobs, and make sure every job gets billed and paid. The company is laid back, not corporate, and the work is steady all year.

What you'll do

  • Answer all plumbing calls. Ask clear questions and write down the caller's name, phone number, address, problem, and next step.
  • Book plumbing jobs in FieldPulse, the company's system for customers, bookings, and invoices.
  • Each day, call the customers served the day before. Check that the work went well and that they paid.
  • Check that the plumbers sent every invoice. Follow up with customers on unpaid bills.
  • Go over paid and unpaid bills with the owner each week.
  • Follow up with customers and the owner on price quotes and new job requests until each one has a next step.
  • Help with permits for plumbing jobs.
  • Send calls to the appliance team when needed, and pick up plumbing calls that come through their side.
  • Keep the owner updated through WhatsApp and your work email.

You'll do well here if

  • You pay close attention to details and follow up without being asked.
  • You speak clear English and feel at ease on calls with U.S. customers.
  • You take good notes and keep your own list of open items.
  • You stay calm and firm with rude customers. Some calls in the trades get rough, and you need a backbone.
  • You learn new systems fast. You don't need to know FieldPulse on day one.

This may not be your role if
This is not a script only call center job, and it is not only customer service. You will own calls, jobs, and unpaid bills until they are closed. If you want to pass each call on and stop there, this role is not for you.

Experience that helps

  • Work in the trades or another home service business. Plumbing is not required.
  • A business or office admin background.
  • Use of FieldPulse or another CRM or job system.
  • Spanish. The company serves areas with many Spanish speaking customers.

Home office needs

  • A quiet place for calls, steady internet, and a headset that sounds clear.
  • A phone with WhatsApp, which the team uses to talk every day.

What good work looks like

  • The owner no longer has to answer most plumbing calls.
  • Every job gets an invoice, and every customer from the day before gets a check in call.
  • Unpaid bills get followed up until they are paid.
  • Quotes and new requests move forward without the owner having to remind you.
  • Calls reach the right team with clear notes and a next step.

How to apply
Apply through our careers page and send your resume as a PDF. You will also take a short online test. It has a typing test, an English grammar test, and three short video answers. It takes about 10 to 15 minutes. Please do it all at one time. We will review complete applications.

What to expect

  • Apply and take the short test.
  • Talk with our recruiting team.
  • Meet the hiring manager.
  • Complete a background check. If all goes well, we will send an offer.
